content.title: SC0 stage-blind generic read-only two-contract envelope
content.description: Read-only wrapper: exactly two independently versioned semantic owners; optional facade dispatches without estimating/merging and without adding a semantic owner. All ref hashes fixture-independent; same semantic meaning may have distinct provider physical provenance. This is a proposal, not an implemented API or production validation.

resolveWorld.atomicity: one immutable selected scope; no mixing versions or time policies; optional missing entries explicit; mandatory missing prevents positive complete claim

conditionPossibility.atomicity: N10E may run without N9. Any N10W claim requires a complete qualified N9 snapshot and N10E result bound to the same declared use.

adapter_rules: dispatch one of two contracts, preserve original semantic refs and native units
materialize/dereference under exact item permission and return values-read refs
no probability invention, household/actor entity invention, cross-release silent pooling or interpretation of GENERATED_RUNTIME_FACT_REF as observation

x-conservation-invariants: Native finite original strata by source/version are retained; governed Absolute Horizon is a separately typed set of refs and never stratum N+1. No historical fixed strata names appear in public API.
N-ary participant cardinality, role order, route identity, motif and F2 producer predicates/history requirement refs remain reversible. Actor-history satisfaction is not computed upstream.
Objective public sanction/power/authority/category is condition evidence only, not personal recognition, feeling, desire, experience or automatically realized event.

Four clocks distinguish evidence valid/effective, publication and knowledge-as-of, caller actor scene, and request/currentness; historical reconstruction does not confer retrospective actor knowledge.
All negative/unknown statuses scoped; VALID_EMPTY requires closed evaluated scope; MISSING, DENIED_USE, UNDERPOWERED and NONCOMPARABLE never collapse to zero.
Neither original marginal nor category nor gender/age/ref determines psyche, Enneagram, actor memory, desire, recognition experience, household generation or probability of event.

Possibility steps preserve order and cumulative conditioner path even if final predicate sets canonicalize. Numerator/denominator/risk set, uncertainty, weight/design, nonresponse and source-native relation topology are preserved.
P(A|B) and P(B|A) require separately qualified target/condition operations, numerator/denominator, risk set, sampling unit and model/use grants; no automatic reversal.

Historical snapshot is immutable; publication/policy boundary changes are channel A, caller GENERATED_RUNTIME_FACT_REF fingerprint changes channel B; both require successor queries rather than mutation of a prior receipt.
Physical indexes/JSON stage names are nonsemantic and may change if every declared identity, dependency, use and dereferenceable semantic value survives.
content.x-fail-closed: No missing origin, grant, sampler, predicate, closure or model authority is auto-filled. Emit typed HOLD/DEFER on that requested grain, preserve lawful unrelated selected facts.

meta.runner_contract: For each case: run providers A and B through the two proposed envelope interfaces and consumers; validate against 01 schema; normalize only explicitly listed physical provenance fields; reverse-dereference all semantic payloads; compare stable semantic path/value and consumer effect; report every mismatch/skip.

physical_B.serialization: normalized rows with split temporal and n-ary tables

consumers.output: eligible scenario constraints and minority alternatives; no parent object, partner selection or biography
possible apprenticeship/education access routes and restrictions; no generated learner psyche

procedure: load A then B under identical use ceiling
resolve same world demand with same four clocks
query three ordered empirical steps
dereference all semantic objects
invoke each of two consumers under same rule version
use NONPARENT_APPRENTICESHIP_ENTRY
exclude genealogical selectors from request
B shuffles physical record order and renames all stage-shaped files
semantic refs and values preserved
B omits sponsor participant or converts triad into dyads
B marks fixture synthetic route as observed source fact
request reversal from B without separate target risk-set issuer
B drops dependency use atom while preserving bytes
same timestamp, generated location binding changes
next run crosses publication boundary independently

acceptance.strict: zero undeclared semantic/consumer differences across both providers and both consumers on the equivalent case
acceptance.failure: any conserved field difference blocks physical C0 freeze; no universal proof beyond listed fixture

meta.scope: One intentionally dense fictional world with explicit sourcefree evidence and unrelated nonparent consumer; not a claim to all35 coverage or actual science.

steps: instantiate baseline with named refs and result claims under TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY
round-trip through proposed facade and separately exposed two contracts
apply mutation one at a time
classify exact changed descendants and invariant unrelated consumer fields
deny output when no issuer/model permission
record status for EVERY case, including skips
runner_contract.normalization: No loss of semantic information; allowable storage/reference encoding changes only. Compare authoritative semantic IDs, structured values, clocks, source grade and selected-read receipts.
